title: Meditation Streak and Consistency
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=meditation:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(minutes) as minutes by _time
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(minutes>0,1,0))) as streak reset_after="(minutes=0)"
| sort - _time
description: Tracks your meditation streak and daily minutes so a mindfulness habit stays visible and rewarding.
value: A visible streak is one of the strongest motivators for a daily practice that is otherwise easy to skip.
implementation: Ingest meditation sessions into `index=personal`; schedule daily and surface the current streak.
visualization: Calendar heatmap of meditation days with the current streak.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how many days in a row you have meditated, which keeps the calming habit going.
